title: Longest Common Substring Length
prompt: Implement `longest_common_substring_length(first, second)` for two strings. Return the length of the longest substring that appears contiguously in both strings. A substring cannot skip characters. Return 0 if there is no common character or either string is empty.

example.reasoning: The longest contiguous match is 'ab' or 'de', each of length two.
